```{r}
library(jointseg)
library(ggplot2)
library(posir)
source(here::here("inst", "scripts", "posird", "utils_competitors.R"))

```

The aim of this vignette is to analyze a real data application of posird.


```{r}
affyDat <- acnr::loadCnRegionData(dataSet = "GSE11976", tumorFraction = 1)
unique(affyDat$region)
sum(is.na(affyDat$b))
mu_l <- mean(subset(affyDat, region == "(0,1)")$c) # loss
mu_0 <- mean(subset(affyDat, region == "(1,1)")$c) # normal
mu_g <- mean(subset(affyDat, region == "(1,2)")$c) # gain

dat <- subset(affyDat, region %in% c("(0,1)", "(1,1)", "(1,2)"))
K_true <- 5
n <- 1e4
set.seed(20250603)
sim <- getCopyNumberDataByResampling(n, K_true, regData = dat, minLength = 200)
Y <- sim$profile$c
Y2 <- sim$profile$b
true_bkp <- sim$bkp
ylims <- rbind(0.5, 3)

# trasformation into decrease in heterozygosity
# Decrease in heterozygosity
Y3 <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y2))
is_het <- sim$profile$genotype == 0.5
Y3[is_het] <- 2 * abs(Y2[is_het] - 0.5)

# Plot
par(mfrow=c(2,1))
plot(Y, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,  
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Copy number")
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")

plot(Y2, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Allelic ratio",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")

par(mfrow = c(2, 1))

plot(Y, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Copy number")
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")

plot(Y3, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Decrease in heterozygosity",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")

mean(is_het)
mean(is.na(Y3))

# trasformation into C1 C2
# Decrease in heterozygosity
C1 <- C2 <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y2))
C1[is_het] <- Y[is_het]*(0.5*(1 - Y2[is_het]))
C2[is_het] <- Y[is_het]*(0.5*(1 + Y2[is_het]))
# Plot
par(mfrow=c(2,1))
plot(C1, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,  
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Copy number")
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")

plot(C2, pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     col = ifelse(is_het,"black", "grey50"),
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Allelic ratio",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
abline(v = true_bkp, col = "red")
```

# Preliminary investigation: keep only het

```{r}
Y_het <- cbind(Y[is_het], Y3[is_het])
plot(Y_het[,1], Y_het[,2])
# Remap breakpoints
true_bkp_new <- cumsum(is_het)[true_bkp]

# Plot
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot(Y_het[, 1],
     pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Copy number")
abline(v = true_bkp_new, col = "red")

plot(Y_het[, 2],
     pch = 16, cex = 0.3,
     xlab = "Index", ylab = "Decrease in heterozygosity",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
abline(v = true_bkp_new, col = "red")
```


```{r}
# Assign segment labels based on remapped breakpoints
segment <- findInterval(
  seq_len(nrow(Y_het)) - 1,
  true_bkp_new
) + 1

dat_plot <- data.frame(
  Y = Y_het[, 1],
  Y3 = Y_het[, 2],
  segment = factor(segment)
)

ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Y, y = Y3, color = segment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Copy number (c)",
    y = "Decrease in heterozygosity (d)",
    color = "Segment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## PoSIRd intervals 

### True segmentation

With true changepoints

```{r}
delta <- 0.005
alpha <- 0.05
Qtable <- posir:::read_quantiles(
  here::here("Simulations", "Table_quantiles.txt")
)
posirCR_true <- confidence_regions_1D(Y_het, true_bkp_new, delta, alpha=alpha,
                                      Qtable = Qtable)


mu1_grid <- seq(0, 3, length.out = 400)
mu2_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 400)

plot(
  posirCR_true,
  mu1_grid = mu1_grid,
  mu2_grid = mu2_grid,
  main = "Simultaneous PoSIRd confidence regions",
  show_labels = TRUE,
  data_cex = 0.5,
  show_centers=FALSE
)

```

```{r}
plot_posir1DCR_3d(
  posirCR_true,
  time_aspect = 1.8,
  main = "Simultaneous PoSIRd confidence regions",
  region_location = "middle",
  show_means = TRUE,
  show_jumps = TRUE,
  show_regions = TRUE,
  show_data = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posirCR_true,
  component = 1,
  box = TRUE
)

plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posirCR_true,
  component = 2,
  box = TRUE
)
```

### Estimated segmentation

Let's now try to estimate the number of changepoints. Let's start by asking
a higher number of changepoints

```{r}
K <- 10
seg <- doDynamicProgramming(Y_het, K = K)
seg$bkp
mean(true_bkp_new %in% seg$bkp)

plotSeg(Y_het[,1], breakpoints = list(seg$bkp, true_bkp_new))
legend("topright", legend=c("est", "true"), col = c("red", "green"),
lty = c(1,2))
plotSeg(Y_het[,2], breakpoints = list(seg$bkp, true_bkp_new))
```

We then compute POSIR intervals on this estimated segmentation

```{r}
posirCR_est <- confidence_regions_1D(Y_het, seg$bkp, delta, alpha, 
                                     Qtable = Qtable)
posirCR_est$lengths
sum(!posirCR_est$valid)

plot(
  posirCR_est,
  mu1_grid = mu1_grid,
  mu2_grid = mu2_grid,
  main = "Simultaneous PoSIRd confidence regions (estimated segmentation)",
  show_labels = TRUE,
  data_cex = 0.5,
  show_centers=FALSE
)

par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posirCR_est,
  component = 1,
  box = TRUE
)

plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posirCR_est,
  component = 2,
  box = TRUE
)
```


# Pruning changepoints using overlapping adjacent regions

The confidence region for segment $i$ is

$$
\mathcal C_i =
\left\{
\mu \in \mathbb R^d :
\|\mu-\widehat\mu_i\|_{\widehat\Sigma^{-1}}
\leq \frac{q}{\sqrt{m_i}}
\right\},
$$

where $\|x\|_{\widehat\Sigma^{-1}} =
\sqrt{x^\top\widehat\Sigma^{-1}x}$.

Since all regions share the same covariance matrix, they are
balls under the same Mahalanobis norm. Therefore, two consecutive
regions intersect if and only if the distance between their
centers does not exceed the sum of their radii:

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal C_i \cap \mathcal C_{i+1} \neq \varnothing
\iff
\|\widehat\mu_i-\widehat\mu_{i+1}\|_{\widehat\Sigma^{-1}}
\leq
q\left(
\frac{1}{\sqrt{m_i}}+
\frac{1}{\sqrt{m_{i+1}}}
\right).
}
$$

We remove the breakpoint between segments $i$ and $i+1$
whenever their confidence regions intersect.

```{r}
confidence_regions_overlap <- function(region, i, j) {

  # Undefined confidence regions
  if (!region$valid[i] || !region$valid[j]) {
    return(NA)
  }

  # Squared Mahalanobis distance between centers
  distance_squared <- as.numeric(
    mahalanobis(
      x = matrix(region$means[i, ], nrow = 1),
      center = region$means[j, ],
      cov = region$covariance
    )
  )

  # Sum of the two Mahalanobis radii
  radius_sum <- region$quantile * (
    1 / sqrt(region$lengths[i]) +
    1 / sqrt(region$lengths[j])
  )

  sqrt(distance_squared) <= radius_sum
}

prune_breakpoints_from_posir <- function(posir_obj) {

  bp <- c(0, posir_obj$breakpoints)

  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(bp))

  for (i in seq_len(length(bp) - 1L)) {

    overlaps <- confidence_regions_overlap(
      posir_obj, i, i + 1L
    )

    if (isTRUE(overlaps)) {
      keep[i + 1L] <- FALSE
    }
  }

  bp[keep]
}
```

## Apply pruning to oversegmentation

```{r}
bp_new <- prune_breakpoints_from_posir(posirCR_est)
bp_new
seg$bkp
posirCR_est$lengths
true_bkp_new

kept <- seg$bkp %in% bp_new
orig <- seg$bkp %in% true_bkp_new
cbind(c(seg$bkp, nrow(Y_het)), posirCR_est$valid, posirCR_est$lengths,
      kept, orig)
```
